notes: Added New Note, New Alarm and New Event shortcuts that can be pinned individually to the Android Home Screen
Long-pressing the Pulse Suite icon now shows the same three quick-create actions
Added Home Screen Shortcuts controls inside Settings
Each shortcut routes directly to the matching create screen
Outdated or missing companion apps are detected and redirected to Apps & Updates
Added a clean launcher-style Home with dedicated Pulse Alarm, Pulse Calendar, Pulse Notes and Settings tiles
App tiles now open their Pulse app directly and show installed readiness at a glance
Moved Pulse Account, Workspace Status, Apps & Updates, Appearance, What's New and About into Settings
Removed Open buttons from Settings and replaced them with Install, Update or Updated states
Retained the built-in Pulse Suite updater and version history
Pulse Suite is now the sole app launcher for the Pulse ecosystem
Fixed installed Pulse app detection and refresh after installer return
Added tactile button press animation and haptic feedback
Pulse Alarm, Calendar and Notes are hidden from the system app drawer after update
Pulse Notes now inherits the active Pulse Suite account and workspace session
Pulse Account and workspace home
Install, open and update Pulse Alarm, Calendar and Notes
Guided Install / Update All
Light and dark appearance
Built-in update channel and version history
